notes: cite.py --check 13.18.35.3 "LINE and LINES are synonyms." OK (13.18.35.3 2)). No binder or emitter path reads which spelling was written (ScreenReportLineClauses and ReportRepetitionOf read only reportLineOperand), so the two are semantically identical by construction; conformance:cases/13.18.35-LINE/l1c16_report_lines_synonym and conformance:cases/13.18.14-COLUMN/pb1221_report_keyword_prefixes (LINES ARE PLUS 1, LINES PLUS 1) witness it.
